about: The Blue Mountains is a town in Grey County, Ontario, on Nottawasaga Bay, covering Craigleith, Thornbury, and the Blue Mountain ski resort—not the separate Town of Collingwood. Escarpment slopes, apple country, and a Georgian Bay harbour at Thornbury define the municipality. About 9,000 people live in The Blue Mountains.
